included: two-stage metal-hydride compressor stage pressure response
excluded: ESD, leak, fire or consequence-distance validation

protocol.candidate_holdout: one untouched experiment selected by identifier before row access
protocol.calibration: no coefficient fitting from the holdout; use the existing compressor model and declared boundary assumptions
protocol.acceptance: diagnostic only; no readiness gate promotion or runtime parameter update

claim_boundary: This protocol can support a component plausibility diagnostic only. It cannot validate an HRS full loop, vehicle filling, safety response, HyRAM consequence distance or LLM effectiveness.
